params.message:
A draft from the Studio on its real article page, behind a link that runs out

GET /preview/{token} exchanges the token with the pipeline
(GET /internal/projection/preview/:token, the projection channel and token the
site already uses) and renders the draft with pages.article as a member reads
it. The payload is mapped by the same code as a published post
(Projection::articleAttributes) but never saved: no Article row, no tagging
record.

What keeps it private: the token is 32 random characters, valid half an hour,
known to the pipeline only as a hash; a malformed token never leaves the site;
the route is throttled; the page sends X-Robots-Tag noindex, Cache-Control
no-store and Referrer-Policy no-referrer, carries a robots meta instead of a
canonical, no Article schema and no feedback strip; robots.txt disallows
/preview/. It is open past the holding page, since the link is its own lock. A
link that ended and one that never was show the same page (404).
